summary: V10_HEARTBEAT_LIVENESS_DECOUPLING_READY. The frozen V9 caller requires initial cross-task Coach delivery and verified readback before the sole normally due heartbeat. The supplied 2026-08-11 trace proves those platform capabilities were unavailable and the empty-receipt heartbeat attempt was rejected before reaching the server, leaving canonical progress due despite otherwise ready Worker, policy, V9 attestation and queues. Static code proves the server and Worker already accept an empty receipt list: no receipt removes no pending event, existing delivery ids and immutable queued/deadline timestamps remain unchanged, and canonical status continues to expose truthful PENDING_WITHIN_SLA or BREACH_PENDING_DELIVERY_PROOF state. Delivery verification can therefore be decoupled from heartbeat liveness without weakening attestation, due-time, queue, evidence, candidate, OOS, deduplication, receipt or Trading gates. The minimum successor is a versioned V10 caller/attestation slice: when delivery capability is unavailable, send zero receipts, report delivery debt, and invoke at most the otherwise-valid normally due heartbeat. Immediate PnL and drawdown effects are zero. The benefit is limited to prospective evidence continuity and reduced learning latency; predictive and economic value remain MISSING_PROOF. This result is NON_COUNTING.
